editorial_corrections.before: The successive ratios only decrease, so the geometric bounds apply
editorial_corrections.after: C/S value-term ratios decrease and are bounded by rho; their derivative ratios are bounded by (K+1)rho/K. T value-term ratios are bounded by Y and derivative ratios by (K+1)Y/K for indices at least K.
editorial_corrections.reason: T value-term ratios increase toward Y, but stay below that geometric upper bound. This clarifies the already correct tail estimates without changing a formula, certified domain or numerical result.
